messages:
harper: Noticed a regression in canary after the quota/routing tweak. Charts are stalling on first interaction for ~250ms. Happening on a fresh profile with no cache.

lee: saw similar on my machine. timeline shows a long task around svg parse + telemetry init. Might be prefetch ordering + a new telemetry init that is blocking main thread.

toni: confirm. New quota enforcement path added in gateway prioritizes telemetry handshake before asset routing. That handshake is synchronous for now. Diff: 
```diff
- routeOrder = ["assets", "api"]
+ routeOrder = ["telemetry", "assets"]
```

mel: ugh. that will increase cold load latency for chart bundles. Also our last client release inlined tiny-svg-utils into charts bundle (to avoid a separate request) which now backfires when asset load itself is delayed.

harper: TL;DR: telemetry before assets + inlined svg lib = main thread hit. Two fast mitigations: 1) make telemetry init async (fire-and-forget) OR 2) temporarily revert routeOrder in canary.

lee: +1 async telemetry init. It's low-risk and keeps quota checks in place. We can also schedule a bundle split for svg-utils next sprint.

toni: Async init needs a debounce to avoid too many early telemetry events causing quota ratchets. Suggest: initTelemetry({blocking: false, batchWindowMs: 200})

perf-bot: perf alert: console-canary heatmap LCP increased by 18% at 2026-03-21T10:03:00Z, correlated with routing-change v1.4.7.

mel: I'll open a tiny PR to flip initTelemetry to non-blocking and add a feature flag. If tests pass, we can flip it in the canary tonight.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy: canary patch (feature-flag telemetry-nonblocking) at 2026-03-21T18:00:00Z. Runbook ID RB-134.

harper: after deploy let's watch route fanout, kvcache miss, and main-thread long tasks. If LCP improves and cache-miss stabilizes, proceed with bundle split plan in next sprint.

lee: also adding a synthetic that simulates cold load with telemetry handshake enabled to our perf dashboard. command we'll use: 
```bash
make perf-sim PROFILE=cold RUNS=50 TARGET=canary
```

toni: good. ping me once the synthetic is up and I'll validate quota metrics (requests/sec per token bucket).

mel: PR opened: https://git.redwood/console/pulls/281 - non-blocking telemetry + feature flag.

harper: thanks, team. small, controlled change; should be low-risk. I'll notify CS and set a short watch window. :+1:
